metadata.target: Any low-level-or-greater resistance across the fully observed 12-drug RT/IN panel

protocol.selection: Highest mean 4-fold facility-grouped training AUROC; fixed candidate grid.
protocol.calibration: Logistic calibration fitted on independent calibration facilities only.
protocol.cutoff: Maximise balanced accuracy on separate cutoff facilities; ties prefer higher sensitivity.
protocol.evaluation: One legacy-test comparison after selection; previously examined, not independent external validation.
protocol.promotion: Candidate only. No automated replacement of the deployed artifact.

paired_comparison.note: Conditions on the selected models and reused legacy cohort; not model-selection uncertainty.

limitations: Retrospective referred-and-tested cohort; cannot establish performance in untested low-risk patients.
Facility-disjoint evaluation reduces repeated-record leakage; stable person identifiers were unavailable, so transfers across facilities cannot be excluded.
Adherence is absent from original data and is not an ML input. Psychosocial, mutations, resistance fields, decisions and post-DRT outcomes are excluded as inputs.
Prior viral loads require a dated observation on or before the index sample. ART duration is derived at that sample date.
Outcome requires all 12 panel results and excludes PI-only resistance. Potential low-level resistance is below the binary target threshold.
Not prospectively validated. Estimates support a research demonstration; they do not confirm resistance or determine treatment/referral.
Legacy test previously inspected; this is not a fresh independent validation.
No new clinical records were added. History features, when enabled, use only observations dated on or before sample collection.
No prospective validation or clinical operating cutoff is established.
